caption: The drawing shows a rectangular rug with a beige background and a central bouquet of flowers. The bouquet includes red, orange, pink, purple, and white flowers with green leaves. The edges of the rug have an ornate border composed of brown scrollwork and green leafy patterns, surrounded by a dark green outer edge. The floral arrangement is set in the middle of the rug, with the flowers tightly clustered and their stems and leaves extending downward. The brown scrollwork and green decor frame the bouquet, providing separation between the central design and the dark border. The rug’s design consists of small, textured brush or pen strokes giving a hooked-rug appearance. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner and is done on a plain, off-white background.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
